lastCompletedStory.title: Capture spawn stderr in the production loopSpawnFn and build the verified-dispatch helper

nextStoryContext: makeProductionLoopSpawnFn now returns decoded stdout and stderr plus exitCode for every sidecar loop phase. runVerifiedDispatch is the shared but not-yet-wired dispatch primitive: it reads pane_pid before set-option/respawn-pane and after respawn-pane, rejects non-zero tmux commands and unchanged zero-exit identities, and independently attempts the dispatch-failed event, durable marker, and notification sinks. Later wiring stories should pass every production dispatch through this helper and remove the durable marker only on their specified successful convergence path.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Official Bun spawnSync docs confirm that piped SyncSubprocess stdout and stderr are Buffer values and exit status is exposed; the production adapter decodes both streams symmetrically and preserves exitCode.
